description: Road height restrictions — Brisbane City Council is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Low clearance bridges and structures are struck by vehicles resulting in damage to the structure and delays to the road network, and public transport when railway bridges are struck. Bridge strikes have unfortunately resulted in serious and fatal injuries to vehicle drivers, passengers and to other road users. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Assets and Facilities. Its keywords are arcgis, council facilities, roads traffic and parking, spatial data, boating, bridge. The portal shows 20 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
